justification: Endpoint_Agents_API_AgentTransfer wraps its one object in a single-member allOf, leaving the member anonymous. kiota 1.34.1 synthesizes names for anonymous schemas and dedupes structurally identical ones with an unstable canonical winner: roughly one generation in five emits this model as models/agents.go and the rest as models/proxies.go (same shape, flipped name), which makes `sdk generate -check` fail on a tree that is not actually stale. allOf with a single member is definitionally identical to that member, so collapsing it changes no wire contract and gives the model its component's own stable name.
